title: Inbox triage
summary: Labels new mail threads, drafts replies in your style, and sends a reply only after a person approves it.

stages.title: Read new threads
stages.does: Lists and reads threads received inside the look-back window.

stages.title: Label and summarise
stages.does: Gives each thread one label and a short factual summary.

stages.title: Draft replies
stages.does: Drafts a reply for each thread that needs one, in the house reply style.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

stages.title: Approve each reply
stages.does: A person approves, edits or declines each draft; the gate times out after 24 hours.

stages.title: Send approved replies
stages.does: On a later run, sends only the drafts whose decision is approved, exactly as approved.

connectors.label: Mail (read)
connectors.purpose: Read new threads in the mailbox.
connectors.connect: Add a mail connector with read access to the routine's environment.

connectors.label: Mail for approvals
connectors.purpose: Carry each approval request for a draft reply.
connectors.connect: Add a mail connector to the routine's environment before you turn gated messages on.

connectors.label: Mail (send)
connectors.purpose: Send a reply a person approved.
connectors.connect: Give the mail connector send access only when you are ready for approved replies to go out.
